comments.body:
Another point that helped me a lot:
Part of ETH is that it’s not about learning facts, it’s about solving problems. So take the exercises and do them. Correct yourself. Repeat keep doing every single exercise until you get them right and understand them. 

Then start the exact same process on the old exams. Just keep solving problems, the knowledge will come with that. 

Source: passed all exams without ever feeling I learned anything except for problem solving skills (which is exactly what employers want, btw)
comments.author: relativisticcobalt
